events.title: "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as "The White Album," in 1968.

angles.name: The Iconic Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling masterpiece. Still sounds as fresh and inventive as ever.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Tribute
events.blurb: The music world remembers Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the one and only Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, simply unmatched.

events.title: "Rubber Soul" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in 1965.

angles.name: A Shift in Sound
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them push their sound in new directions.

events.title: John Lennon Tribute
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: Remembering a Visionary
angles.copy: Forty-six years since John Lennon's passing. His music and message continue to resonate.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: The Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: David Bowie would have been 80 today. An artist who constantly reinvented himself and pushed boundaries. His influence is still everywhere.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His impact on music and culture remains unmatched.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy birthday to legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, who turns 83 today.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page. Those iconic riffs are still giving us goosebumps.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of rock legend Sir Rod Stewart, who is 82 today.

angles.name: Still Rockin' at 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to Sir Rod Stewart! The distinctive voice and endless hits. What's your favourite Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy birthday to Suggs, lead singer of Madness, who celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: One Step Beyond 65
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness. Always bringing the house down.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy birthday to pop and soul singer Paul Young, who turns 71 today.

angles.name: Wherever He Lays His Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! That unmistakable voice gave us so many 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Celebrating the enduring legacy of the legendary singer, songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton, who would have turned 81 today.

angles.name: A True Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Dolly Parton would have been 81 today. A force of nature, a songwriting genius, and an absolute icon. Her music lives on.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a happy birthday to Take That frontman and songwriter Gary Barlow, who turns 56 today.

angles.name: Mr. Take That Turns 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting legend, he's done it all.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the iconic British soul singer Billy Ocean, who celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen Turns 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to Billy Ocean! The voice behind so many feel-good classics. Get out and 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car'!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place, honouring pioneers of music.

angles.name: Hall of Fame Firsts
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years since the inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who were the first legends to get the nod?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy birthday to Take That member Mark Owen, who turns 55 today.

angles.name: Celebrating Mark Owen
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to his solo ventures, always a fan favourite.

events.title: Beatles Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps in London in 1969.

angles.name: That Iconic Rooftop Gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their impromptu rooftop concert. What a way to go out.

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Wishing a happy birthday to the legendary drummer and singer Phil Collins, who is 76 today.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight, He's 76
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the one and only Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, from Genesis to solo superstardom.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy birthday to beloved British actor Hugh Grant, who celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: A Very British Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 67th birthday to the king of the rom-com, Hugh Grant. What's your favourite of his films?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy birthday to pop superstar Justin Timberlake, who turns 46 today.

angles.name: Bringing Sexy Back at 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From boyband sensation to solo icon, he's still got it.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the national treasure Sir David Jason, who celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly, Sir David!
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television.

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1959, music legends Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash, an event known as "The Day The Music Died".

angles.name: A Tragic Day in Music
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, we lost three pioneers: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. The day the music truly died.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Wishing a happy birthday to the voice behind "Never Gonna Give You Up," Rick Astley, who turns 61 today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Up on Him
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on those classic 80s tunes.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and music of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today.

angles.name: One Love, One Legend
angles.copy: Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, who celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent at 85
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King. A true songwriting genius whose music defines generations.

events.title: Whitney Houston Tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston, who passed away on this day in 2012.

angles.name: The Voice We Miss
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost Whitney Houston. Her voice was pure magic and her songs remain timeless.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, pop phenomenon Take That announced their initial split, devastating fans across the nation.

angles.name: The Day The Tears Flowed
angles.copy: Twenty-one years ago, the pop world was in mourning as Take That announced their split. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy birthday to Ali Campbell, lead singer of UB40, who celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine and 68!
angles.copy: Wishing a happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40. Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran, who turns 36 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday, Ed!
angles.copy: He's only 36 today, but Ed Sheeran has already achieved so much. Happy birthday to one of the biggest artists on the planet!
